Name: GenAI
Segments:
- LLM & GenAI Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in fine-tuning (SFT, LoRA), aligning (RLHF/DPO), or distilling LLMs specifically for search, recommendation, or NLP tasks (e.g., query expansion, dense retrieval, reranking).
- Contributing to AI Strategy: Partnering with senior leadership to shape GenAI architecture direction, tooling decisions, and platform roadmap within your area.
- This role applies GenAI/LLM capabilities to real data-engineering workflows, turning prototypes into reliable internal tools that improve engineering productivity, operational efficiency, and data access.

Name: Equinix Fabric
Segment: Equinix Fabric

Name: CSDM
Segments:
- Build and maintain automated workflows for the hardware lifecycle, following Common Service Data Model (CSDM) best practices to keep the Asset and CI tables in sync.
- Preferred Licensure/Certification: ITILv4, ITILv4 Foundations, CSDM (Certified Service Desk Manager), HDI-SCM, SDI Service Desk Manager, ISO/IEC 20000, COBIT 2019, CompTIA A+, Google IT Support
- Deep knowledge of the CMDB data model, CI class hierarchy, IRE (Identification & Reconciliation Engine), Discovery patterns, probes, sensors, and service mapping. Experience with CSDM (Common Service Data Model) alignment.

Name: NTB
Segments:
- Familiarity with communication protocols such as Ethernet MAC, PHY, Switching, TCP/IP, Security, SerDes, PCIe, NTB, and SR-IOV.
- Fluency in core digital-shelf and retail-media metrics is a necessity, with direct Scintilla digital landscape and paid/organic funnel experience preferred (e.g., glance views, sessions, CVR, CTR, ROAS, TACoS, and NTB)
- Communication protocols like Ethernet MAC, PHY, Switching, TCP/IP, Security, Serdes, PCIe, NTB, and SR-IOV.

Name: Caldera
Segment: Testing & Automation (Bonus): Sigma, YARA, Atomic Red Team, Caldera, Python and SOAR playbooks.

Name: D Engineering
Segments:
- Manage and/or execute R&D engineering deliverables to maintain overall project schedule, with an emphasis on technical tasks and deliverables
- The Access Management team is part of Okta R&D Engineering.
- Prior startup, skunkworks, or advanced R&D engineering experience.

Name: IDP
Segments:
- Knowledge of IdP/SAML integration.
- Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) or Identity Provider (IdP) platforms such as JumpCloud, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, or similar.
- Strong experience with internal developer platforms (IDP) and enabling self-service ecosystems

Name: CD pipeline management
Segments:
- Collaborate with DevOps teams for CI/CD pipeline management and infrastructure as code (IaC) deployments.
- Hands-on experience with GitLab for source control, CI/CD pipeline management, and GitOps workflows
- This semi-senior role focuses on implementing advanced DevOps practices, including automation, monitoring, CI/CD pipeline management, and incident response, while contributing to strategic initiatives and providing mentorship to junior team members.

Name: Bridgewater
Segments:
- Legend Biotech is seeking a Senior HRIS Analyst, Data Governance & Change Control as part of the Human Resources Operations team based in Bridgewater, NJ.
- Legend Biotech is seeking a Sr Manager, Quality IT as part of the Quality IT team based in Bridgewater, NJ.
- Legend Biotech is seeking a Treasury Analyst (Contractor) as part of the Finance team based in Bridgewater, NJ.

Name: Coupa
Segments:
- Proficiency with tools e.g. Google Workspace, Brightflag, Docusign, Salesforce, Coupa, Confluence, Jira and Office365
- Familiarity with SAP, Coupa, Tableau, Domo, Power BI, or similar enterprise platforms.
- You are willing to learn how to use corporate systems (e.g. Salesforce, Coupa, Anaplan) and analytic / dashboarding tools (e.g. Palantir Foundry)

Name: HTTP/2
Segment: Strong understanding of high-performance networking, gRPC, HTTP/2, streaming protocols, API gateways, and service proxy architectures.

Name: STLC
Segments:
- QA Methodologies: Deep understanding of software verification principles, the STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle), and test case optimization.
- Experience participating in the Software Test Life Cycle (STLC), including test planning, test case design, and execution in an Agile environment
- Hands-on expertise across the whole STLC, including testing patterns and architectures (e.g., Page Object Model, fixtures and factories, data-driven testing) and end-to-end test design strategies.

Name: USB
Segment: Home automation protocols (Z-Wave, Zigbee), USB, Ethernet, sensors, and power management

Name: Adaptive Insights
Segment: Experience with ERP and financial planning systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Hyperion, Anaplan, or Adaptive Insights)

Name: App Store
Segments:
- Nice to Have: CI/CD for mobile (Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions), App Store deployment and release management and automated testing (XCTest, snapshot testing)
- Every system you build should minimize human intervention, from code push to app store submission.
- Support App Store release validation and regression testing for mobile releases

Name: Music
Segments:
- We turn music, entertainment, culture, and the creativity of our community into new ways to play and connect.
- SoundCloud empowers artists and fans to connect and share through music.
- Ballots for exclusive tickets to events like Formula 1, UFC, and more sporting and music events

Name: CentOS 7+
Segment: In-depth knowledge of the Linux OS (RHEL 7+/CentOS 7+) and its core components, including the kernel, system libraries, and package management (RPM, YUM).

Name: Graph RAG
Segments:
- Embed AI into Data, Pipelines, & Analytics: Advance both the central and federated teams to become truly AI-ready. Design and implement strategies to embed AI directly into enterprise analytics, including building complex data pipelines (ETL), custom data apps, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG / Graph RAG) architectures directly on the data platform
- Experience with Graph RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation): hybrid retrieval across graph traversal and dense/sparse vector search
- Develop advanced Graph-RAG architectures combining semantic search and structured knowledge retrieval.

Name: PMI-PBA
Segments:
- Exposure to cybersecurity or GRC programs; CAPM, PMI-PBA, or CBAP.
- Relevant certifications such as IIBA CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, or Agile Business Analyst.
- ISTQB, CBAP, PMI-PBA, or Agile certifications.

Name: SoD
Segments:
- Design, develop, and maintain QA automation frameworks and automated test suites covering Identity Governance capabilities such as certifications, lifecycle management, workflows, and Separation of Duties (SoD), ensuring high-quality and reliable product releases.
- Strong understanding of IAM/IGA concepts: joiner/mover/leaver, RBAC, role mining, SoD, certifications, and least privilege
- Maintain the Segregation of Duties (SoD) matrix and review access conflicts quarterly.
